text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and water, and avoid too much sugar. Second, try to exercise regularly — even a short walk every day helps. Third, make sure you get enough sleep, because it gives you energy and helps you think clearly. Mental health is just as important as physical health, so take time to relax and talk about your feelings. Finally, keep a good work-life balance: don't spend all your time working or studying, and enjoy time with family and friends. Small daily habits like these make a big difference.
